reviews.x: This is probably one of the best shaving sticks for the dollar. I bought mine several months ago and am just now opening the next one. The smell is pleasant, if bland, and it makes a very rich, thick lather when used with a brush. This product is not vegan, however, and anyone concerned about the inclusion of animal products should be warned that it is made with animal tallow. For a travel soap or an every day soap you can't really beat this stuff, especially at the price.

If you are a wet shaver this stuff is awesome! You can use it as a shave stick and face lather or do as I did and mash it into a container. Using it to bowl lather or face lather. Provide smooth comfortable shaves at a fraction of the price of more spendy shave soaps. Provides great lather and cusion! A must have for the wet shaver.
I'll keep it short. Great price, great lather, great smell, and molds easily into a shave bowl. Truly, a fine product.

This product is an incredible value - possibly the best deal anywhere in the shaving soap/cream market.  Lathers up as well as Truefit & Hill (my benchmark for lather quality and concentration) and is incredibly concentrated, with a little going a very long way.  An unusual scent - a blend of citronella, lemon soap and old corn tortilla  - but I've quickly grown to like it, and the scent of the stick has mellowed since I unwrapped it.  Shaving is all about the experience, and having a Turkish ta

This soap is one that I lather on my face rather than in a mug.  Arko provides a thick, long lasting lather.  The protection from razor burn and nicks is excellent.  The smell is pleasant in my opinion, some have described it as Citronella.  In comparison to other inexpensive shave soaps on the market that I have tried, this is clearly superior to Williams and better than Colonel Conk and Van Der Hagen as well.  I will be ordering more.

reviews.t: A quality soap at a budget soap price
reviews.x: One thing that DE shaving has done to me is it has made me an absolute snob about soap. My favorite so far is Stirling "Naked and Smooth", but this is a close second. The scent on it to me smells like Lemon Pledge, but it does not linger long after your shave. Some people have pressed this stuff into a jar and lathered it that way. I however do the face lather with it (wet face, wet end of stick, rub on face, rub face with brush, watch lather magically appear) and what I get is a good th

reviews.t: ARKO! I'm part of the cult now!
reviews.x: This stuff has a cult-like following on the shaving forum I'm part of so I had to try some.  Used it for the first time today and had a great experience.  I used it as a shave stick, rubbing it all over my face then added my brush and some water then POOF - lots of great lather.  The smell is essentially lemon and is a nice fragrance for the morning.  It does have a bit of an industrial lemon floor cleaner smell to it but thats not that big of a deal.  The shave was great and if you need more la

I join the chorus in complaining about the smell when first opening this soap(Taco Bell cheap tortilla?). It does dissipate in a few weeks. This cylinder gives more foam than any of the three other soaps I use, it's magnificent actually.  One note on how to apply, I tried lobbing off a slither and frothing it up with a badger and it worked well enough. But, the best way to apply this soap is to rub the stick directly on your face then with a wet brush work it. It gives more lather and cuts out t

I have been using one stick for the last 7 months. I am a woman, and don't shave daily, so I'm sure it probably lasts me longer than others. I am only about 1/4 of the way through the stick though, so I anticipate it lasting me at least a full year.  I am pleasantly surprised at how easy it is to use this stick. I take it in the shower with me, wet the end, wet my legs, and smear the stick over my legs. I am able to shave with no foaming involved. It creates a nice slick surface as is. Lately I

This shaving soap foams up into a nice, effective lather.  The smell is lemony to my nose. I have had not a single nick shaving with this product, and it seems like it will last a long time making it very cost-effective.

I have thick coarse stubble. My set up in the past was either proraso, col conk, or kiss my face. I decided to try this arko shave stick based on all the reviews and plus its so cheap. I use the main Merkur everyone has, I think its the 180 and I used a derby blade that had one shave under its belt already.  I purposely didnt shave for about 4 days to get some nice stubble. I also didnt shower before this shave. I wanted to see how it works without the benefit of a hot shower with steam.  I boug

Arko is a must buy for anyone who desires the experience of shaving excellence. It lathers with little effort and provides a rich moisturizing barrier between the face and razor blade. The issue with its strong odor is something that I think gets overblown. I enjoy the fragrance that Arko provides.
This soap is great. Rub it on your wet face and lather up with a brush. Too easy! I love the smell. Clean and fresh strong ivory soap smell.

I discovered the shave stick method of shaving via a You Tube video and became a fan. This Arko brand has a old fashioned barber shop smell that I find pleasant. It is a very economical shaving method and one stick lasted me over a year. I do recommend you get a holder for your shave stick (West Coast Shaving $1.75) as this makes use easier and less messy. Try it. Like stepping back to a better, simpler time...and it is exotic, from Turkey.

Mash it right into a cup. Using it by wetting it and rubbing it on in stick form isn't best. Makes a nice lather and smells nice too. Not a strong aroma at all. Keeps face nice and hydrated during shave. I'll but it again.

For four dollars and fifty cents this was an OK purchase.  ONE stick of shaving soap, that lathers somewhat better than Williams brand shaving soap, shipped from Turkey for under $5 what is not to like?

reviews.t: I've tried over 20 different soaps.. Arko is the best
reviews.x: Try this soap.  You won't be sorry .. Even if you don't like it .. You will see what all the fuss is about .. It's something

reviews.t: ...If Ivory soap and lemon PEZ had a love child
reviews.x: Arko is a great economy shaving soap.  The smell was not offensive at all to me and actually has grown on me somewhat since I started using it.  I can best describe the smell as clean and lemony; if Ivory soap and lemon PEZ had a love child Arko shave soap would come out.  This tallow based soap produces an amazingly thick lather but it takes a bit more work to do so than with a glycerine based soap or cream.  While this soap can be lathered on the face straight from the stick that seemed kind o

reviews.t: Arko Shaving Soap is the one for me.
reviews.x: This is compact, easy to pack in your shaving kit.  The smell is very refreshing.  But the best part is using a shaving brush and suds up a lot.  At first I thought that it was not going to work.  Wet face and rub on your face then use your brush. Way too much lather, if there is such a thing.  It will not take you long to figure out how much to rub on your face.  The brush is what makes it go to town for a big lather.  Am getting more.  Razor gave such a close shave with this dense creamy lathe

reviews.t: STRONG smell at first, but WOW what a soap!
reviews.x: When I first opened this thing I thought, "Oh no, what have I done?"  It smelled like the bathroom of a truck stop in the middle of nowhere.  Like industrial cleaner or a urinal puck (popular opinion for a reason).  I have to tell you though, it WILL wear off.  If you leave it sitting out for a week it mellows out into a very soft and pleasant Ivory Soap smell.  But scent aside, this thing is an absolute performer.  It lathers very well, is slick enough to protect my face (even with hard

If you're used to canned foam and found it satisfactory then don't bother with Arko.  You actually need to swirl up a lather with your shaving brush, but when you do you'll be delighted by the density, creaminess and soothing nature of warm lather prepping your face for blade attack.  Some people think the smell is off-putting but I liken it to the difference between Ivory and Irish Spring - a clean fragrance without cologne note. reviews.t: Amazing Product at an Amazing Price!
reviews.x: Excellent quality at a cheap price and long lasting; more than my money's worth.  If you use this as it's made to be used it will serve you well.  As you can see when you read the ingredients; it is not really scented so I didn't expect it to be. What I wanted was an inexpensive shaving soap that produced long lasting lather, a high degree of 'slickness' that lasts, and as many shaves as possible from each stick. reviews.t: Great Product; Great Value; Cool Features; Read Below!
reviews.x: The Arko shaving soap stick is one amazing "big bang for the buck" product.  I decided to try this highly rated product as part of my venture, right of passage, etc. into DE (double edge/safety razor) shaving and believe cartridge razor uses will also greatly benefit from this minimal investment.  Since it is a stick, it allows me to use it in different ways from a traditional soap or cream.  It provides a luxurious lather with very good cushion.  I apply it as many shavers do; wet face and soap

A very good shaving soap.  Pros: 1. Great lather. I dont have much diversity of experience- but this is better than Col. Conk or Williams. Better, thicker, slicker lather.  2.Its moldable. Good for travel, can be smushed into a variety of lidded containers.  3. Low cost.  Cons:  1. Smell. I personally like it, reminds me of the barbershop shaves I used to get when I was younger. Very nice shave soap! I've only used it a few times but the lather is easy to build, and the floral scent lasts. When not in use I keep this around in my med. cabinet above the sink and it has kind of served as a pleasant air freshener for the bathroom.  I tore the paper off as needed and slightly wet the end of the stick and rubbed it on my face for a few seconds, then moved onto the brush and built the lather on my face. claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the product as an excellent value and very economical, with sticks lasting a long time.
Most reviewers report it produces a rich, thick, easy lather that gives smooth, comfortable shaves with good razor protection.
Opinions on the scent are mixed: many find it pleasant (lemony, clean, barber-shop), while some describe it as an odd or off-putting smell that fades over time.
Several reviewers note it can be mashed or molded into a container or bowl for use.
A few reviewers mention the product is not vegan.
